## Checklist

- [ ] The change has one measurable acceptance condition.
- [ ] Reference and optimized paths preserve declared numerical/token parity.
- [ ] New malformed or failure cases have tests.
- [ ] Performance language follows `docs/BENCHMARKING.md`.
